name: Suzuki DR-Z400
engine: 398 cc liquid-cooled DOHC single, carb (the new 2025 DR-Z4S is fuel injected)
intro: A tough dual-sport. The stator, the front sprocket nut and the bearings are the things to watch.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2025-2026 models are in recall 25V873 for the rear brake.
A-002.reason: A brake problem can cost you stopping power. The fix is free.

add.title: Check the front sprocket nut
add.instructions: Pull the sprocket cover and check the front sprocket nut is tight and locked.
add.reason: Owners say the front sprocket nut coming loose is a common problem.

G: Older bikes have a carb. The 2025 DR-Z4S is fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match your bike.

recalls.what: Rear brake fastener issue that could cause a loss of braking power.

known.title: Stator
known.what: Hard starting on older bikes is often a stator that failed early.
